pages.text: The duplexer lets the repeater send and receive on one antenna at once. Its six $(thing)cavity screws$() are tuned to frequencies: the three on the left to the output (TX), the three on the right to the input (RX). Each shows its frequency.

A new duplexer is $(thing)factory tuned$(): it follows its repeater. Turn a screw and it is yours: retune it whenever you change the repeater's frequencies. A cavity off frequency loses signal and shows the transmitter a bad SWR.
pages.title: Tuning
